Sea Sports Coffee Cruise

Hyannis, MA · Cape Cod · Road

No-drop

Sea Sports Coffee Cruise is a road group ride in Hyannis, MA. It rolls every Saturday at 7:30 am from Sea Sports Cyclery & Outdoor. About 20–30 miles, 16–18 mph, no-drop.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 7:30 am. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Expect 16–18 mph: brisk — you'll want some fitness. It's no-drop: if you fall off the back, someone waits. That's the point of a group ride.
Check
Look at @capecodseasports the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Sea Sports Coffee Cruise group ride

A year-round Saturday road ride from the shop in Hyannis. No-drop at 16 to 18 mph. In summer the shop also runs a Monday easy mountain bike ride and alternating Tuesday gravel and Wednesday road rides. A yearly waiver and a helmet are required.
